import re
with open('server/src/core/WorldTick.ts') as f:
    content = f.read()
# Remove strings and comments roughly
content = re.sub(r'//.*', '', content)
content = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', content, flags=re.DOTALL)
content = re.sub(r'\"[^\"]*\"', '\"\"', content)
content = re.sub(r\"'[^']*'\", \"''\", content)
opens = content.count('{') + content.count('(') + content.count('[')
closes = content.count('}') + content.count(')') + content.count(']')
print(f'Open: {opens}, Close: {closes}')
print(f'Diff: {opens - closes}')
# Check for extra closing braces
lines = content.split('\n')
depth = 0
for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
    if '{' in line or '(' in line or '[' in line:
        depth += line.count('{') + line.count('(') + line.count('[')
    if '}' in line or ')' in line or ']' in line:
        depth -= line.count('}') + line.count(')') + line.count(']')
    if depth < 0:
        print(f'Negative at line {i}: {line[:50]}')
        break
else:
    if depth != 0:
        print(f'Non-zero final: {depth}')
    else:
        print('Braces balanced')
